description: Business class miles & credit card transfer calculator: compares today’s cheapest cash fare on Aviasales with published/derived saver award bands across 19 airline programs (Avios, Flying Blue, Aeroplan, KrisFlyer, Miles & More, ANA, Skywards…) and 43 bank point programs (Amex, Chase, Citi, Capital One, Bilt, Revolut…), returning cents-per-mile value and the cash booking link.

card_market.description: Optional 2-letter country code to filter credit card transfer partners (US, GB, DE, FR, IT, ES, CA, AU, SG, HK, AE, IN, JP, BR).

from.description: City name (e.g. "Milan", "New York") or 3-letter IATA city/airport code (e.g. "MIL", "JFK").

to.description: City name (e.g. "Milan", "New York") or 3-letter IATA city/airport code (e.g. "MIL", "JFK").

name: cash_vs_miles_options
title: Cash vs points/miles & credit-card transfer paths for Business Class
